scope.purpose: primary factual source inventory for named local hero candidates

method.access: read-only public web/indexed official texts and official map API responses; no computer/browser UI used
method.source_read_scopes: Each row labels opened body, official indexed extract, preserved newspaper PDF, or unresolved lookup. A failed open is not described as a full page read.
method.name_policy: Names are copied from source text/tag values. Variants and candidate-to-object alias claims remain explicit and unassumed.
method.location_policy: Catalogue anchors are copied unchanged. A city association is not inferred from a nearby feature; incomplete cases remain flagged.
method.legal_policy: Source facts do not grant rights to copy external geometry, images, or maps. Rights remain unknown unless explicitly recorded.
